status: Research-only patch for isolated after-control; not applied to dist/app.js.
guard: The route default is applied only when the route is not fieldScoped, has no explicit region, and the owner primary sourceContext exactly matches the requested book and printed page.
negativeControls: Unresolved field-target routes do not inherit the whole-record primary region and remain on the cited PDF page with pending target status.
An explicit region permalink takes precedence, including the old legacy full-image ID.
A primary sourceContext with another book or printed page is ignored.
